_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Getting connected on site
framework: Professor Adow TVET — Digital Skills for the Workshop

criteria.text: Distinguish a local network from the internet, and name one job on site that needs each.
Identify the parts of a small site network — the device, the access point or router, and the line leaving the building — and say what each one does.
Choose wired or wireless for a stated job and justify the choice by reliability, distance and interference.
Connect a device to a named network, and recognise when you have joined the wrong one.
criteria.evidence: Observed on a device; screenshot evidence.

criteria.text: Diagnose a connection failure in order: the device is off the network, the network has no route out, or the service itself is down.
State what must never be sent over a shared or public connection, and why a password typed on site is not private by default.
Describe how a job's records reach the office, and what happens to them if the connection drops mid-shift.
